extraction_notes: This is a family datasheet; the BZT52C36S row was selected from the BZT52C2V0S through BZT52C75S electrical-characteristics table.

The Fig. 2 zener-characteristic points are manually digitized readings from the visible plotted BZT52C36S 36 V trace; source-axis current in mA was converted to A and no intermediate points were interpolated.
The BZT52C36S electrical-characteristics row gives VZ minimum 34.0 V, nominal 36.0 V, and maximum 38.0 V at IZT = 2 mA; maximum ZZT is 90 ohm at IZT and maximum ZZK is 350 ohm at IZK = 0.5 mA.
The electrical-characteristics row gives maximum reverse leakage IR = 0.1 microA at VR = 25.2 V and maximum admissible zener current IZM = 2 mA.
The row gives a typical temperature-coefficient range of 30.4 to 37.4 mV/degC at the stated temperature-coefficient test current.

No capacitance value or reverse-recovery time is published in the supplied datasheet. The remaining page 3 capacitance, leakage, temperature-coefficient, and impedance plots are series-wide typical characteristics without a uniquely identified BZT52C36S trace and were not assigned component-specific points.
